text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $84k with modest gains while Ethereum trails slightly at $2,686, suggesting cautious consolidation rather than strong directional momentum in the major pairs. The Fear & Greed index sits at 74 (Greed) and rising, indicating retail sentiment has shifted decidedly optimistic over the past week. Bitcoin dominance at 58.3% paired with $58B daily volume reflects healthy market activity, though the narrow price moves across top altcoins suggest participants are content to wait rather than rotate aggressively into riskier positions.
